Mmbtu/d of 3.36% CO2 gas. =20

Nitrogen 0.1124%

HPLC's permissible H2S content at the wellhead; the Albrecht #4 H2S content=
=20

meter 098-4179, the Miller-Albrecht Unit #1-A and the Hoff Heller Gas Unit=

for this new gas prior to flowing same to HPLC?=20
